scenarios.scenario_abstract: For one backpack serving a two-week trip that includes hiking, [X] compares surface designs only after fit, capacity, access, and durability are settled, looking for a final pattern that remains recognizable in transit without seeming out of place on trail days.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为包含徒步的两周旅行购买背包时，[X]在贴合度、容量、取物方式和耐用性都通过筛选后，才比较不同表面图案，判断哪一种既能在转运行程中容易辨认，又不会在徒步日显得不合时宜。
examples: using Solid, Geometric, Striped, Plaid, or Chevron when the traveler wants a readable but broadly wearable surface
using Camouflage only when trail use outweighs luggage-belt recognition
using Logo or Color Block when recognizability matters without weakening fit or construction

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When choosing a small Japanese gift for a recipient who prefers restrained design, [X] compares reusable shopping bags with other personal accessories and judges whether a cherry-blossom surface feels culturally specific without becoming a loud novelty item.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为偏爱克制设计的人挑选小件日本礼物时，[X]会在可重复使用的购物袋和其他随身配件之间比较，重点判断樱花表面图案能否保留明确的文化意味，同时不显得过分花哨或像廉价纪念品。
examples: using Floral when the blossom repeat remains quiet enough for ordinary carrying
using Solid only as the deliberately plainer alternative to a souvenir print
rejecting unrelated creature motifs merely because they also appear in Japanese decorative crafts

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While refining a recurring comic character, [X] keeps one worn leather satchel recognizable across scenes by deciding how to arrange its mismatched fabric repairs within the character's deliberately limited clothing palette.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在完善一个反复登场的漫画角色时，[X]需要让角色唯一的旧皮挎包在不同场景中保持可辨识，因此会决定颜色各异的补丁布该如何排列，并与角色刻意压缩过的服装配色保持关系。
examples: using Patchwork when the visible repair history remains the defining surface
using Color Block when larger repair panels read as deliberate regions rather than scattered mending
using Graphic or Cartoon only when a later target appears on an established repair panel and does not replace the satchel

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While studying in Madrid, [X] compares several named low-profile laptop bags for daily cafe and campus use, screening their surfaces for whether they still look like ordinary lifestyle bags instead of advertising the expensive workstation inside.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在马德里学习期间，[X]会比较几款有明确品牌或型号的低调笔记本电脑包，用于日常往返校园与咖啡馆，并检查它们的表面是否仍像普通生活用包，而不会把内部昂贵的移动工作站暴露出来。
examples: using Solid or a quiet Geometric, Striped, Plaid, or Chevron repeat when low visibility is the priority
using a restrained Logo only when it does not make the bag look expensive from a distance
rejecting loud Graphic or Cartoon treatments when they defeat the explicitly requested low-profile role

scenarios.scenario_abstract: During a clothing consultation, [X] places a pictured bag beside minimalist garments and judges whether its visible paneling or texture adds enough structure to the combination without making the bag compete with the other accessories.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一次穿搭咨询中，[X]把一只图片中可见的包与极简服装放在一起，判断包身表面的分区或纹理能否为整体增加适量结构感，同时又不让包与其他配饰互相争抢注意力。
examples: using Solid when the bag should recede behind the outfit
using Geometric, Striped, or Color Block when one controlled surface rhythm supplies the outfit's structure
using Quilted when stitched repetition adds texture without introducing a competing picture motif

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For graduation, [X] completes a formal, glamorous look around a multicolored floral dress and chest ruffles and selects a compact clutch with either an understated surface or a restrained detail that echoes one element of the outfit without competing with the dress and jewelry.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为毕业场合准备造型时，[X]围绕多色花卉连衣裙和胸前荷叶边完善正式而华丽的搭配，并挑选一只小巧手拿包。包面可以保持素净，也可以用一处克制的细节呼应穿搭中的某个元素，但不能与裙装和首饰争夺视觉中心。
examples: using Solid as the safest counterweight to the floral dress
using Quilted or a restrained Geometric repeat when texture is wanted without another pictorial motif
using Floral only when scale and color are controlled enough to avoid an accidental mismatch

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an outdoor ladies' golf luncheon with a playful country-club dress theme, [X] chooses a compact crossbody surface that can either repeat the group's animal-print cue or stay visually quiet during lawn games and photographs.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一场采用趣味乡村俱乐部着装主题的女士户外高尔夫午宴中，[X]要为小巧斜挎包选择表面图案：它既可以呼应全组的动物纹元素，也可以在草坪活动和合影中保持视觉克制。
examples: using Leopard Print when it directly echoes the source's playful dress-code cue
using Zebra Print or Snake Print as later animal-pattern variants only when the rest of the outfit stays controlled
using Solid when the crossbody should support rather than repeat the themed clothing

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While preparing a cosplay, [X] checks the costume list against a character depiction, replaces the wrongly described shoulder bag with the backpack shown in the reference, and preserves only surface markings that can be verified from the image.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在准备角色扮演造型时，[X]把服装清单与角色图像逐项核对，发现原先写成的单肩包不对，便改为画面中的背包，并且只保留能够从参考图中确认的包面标记。
examples: using Solid or Color Block according to the visible division of the depicted colors
using Logo, Graphic, or Cartoon only when the corresponding mark is actually visible in the reference
rejecting an attractive but unverified motif because costume accuracy is the source's governing rule

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Within a dated Buenos Aires itinerary, [X] compares leather and handmade bags across a Sunday market, pedestrian shops, and an upscale gallery, judging whether each surface treatment reads as genuine local craft or mass-produced decoration before carrying the purchase through the city.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一份有明确日期的布宜诺斯艾利斯行程中，[X]会在周日市集、步行街商店和高档商场之间比较皮包与手作包，并在带着商品继续穿行城市前，判断各种表面处理究竟像真正的本地工艺，还是批量复制的装饰。
examples: using Paisley, Chevron, Geometric, or Striped only when the seller can connect the repeat to the bag's actual craft
using Quilted when stitching construction, not a printed imitation, creates the surface
using Crocodile Print as an embossed finish to evaluate, without claiming exotic-animal provenance

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before a stadium concert with a strict clear-bag rule, [X] checks whether any pattern on the permitted trim, strap, or tiny alternative clutch remains readable without obscuring contents or slowing entry screening.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在实行严格透明包规定的体育场演唱会前，[X]会检查允许出现于包边、肩带或极小替代手拿包上的图案，确保它既能看清，又不会遮挡包内物品或拖慢入场安检。
examples: using Solid for the transparent body and a plain permitted trim
using Logo or Graphic only on an allowed small surface that does not defeat visibility
using Geometric or Striped on the strap while rejecting any all-over opaque treatment
